status: registered before any GPU work (G1 is CPU-only and was computed first)
recording: not recorded by the team runtime
purpose: repeat GPUSparse paper experiments (arXiv 2606.26441) for the report: quality (G1), collection scaling (G2, paper Table 2) and bandwidth/decomposition (G3, paper Tables 5-6)
label: calibration queries only (500), after the freeze (the held-out queries were used in #27); the 6,480 evaluation queries are not touched

source.u4m: src/cuda_range_v3.cu at the run's HEAD with its defaults; CUDA 12.6 SASS must be 8f8a5d49e0e0ad3f (checked by code/build_g.sh before any GPU work)

G1.what: quality of the exact top-1000 (every exact scorer under the team contract returns it: uint8 impacts, cap-32 query weights)

inputs.qrels: configs/inputs-qrels.json (new external input: MS MARCO passage dev.small qrels, SHA-256 ddc607db...; in run-bulk, not Git)
inputs.run: pinned-provenance CPU oracle top-1000 for the 500 calibration queries (SHA-256 302b63d4fc0c55cb..., Measurement F inputs)

G1.metrics: MRR@10 (MS MARCO official), nDCG@10 (trec_eval ndcg_cut_10), Recall@1000 (trec_eval recall_1000); means over the 500 calibration queries; canonical order and trec_eval tie order (analysis/g1_quality.py)

G2.indexes: 100K and 1M: data/derived/hash-{N}-w4096-pos.rbp and -w1024-pos.rbp (existing; SHA-256 and sizes recorded in the run; the 100K W=4096 index already exists, so it is not rebuilt; its round-trip check is run on the CPU at the start of the session); full: /scratch/ag11163/full-inputs (W=4096 SHA-256 06368cee..., W=1024 c7669620..., Measurement F)
G2.oracles: data/derived/oracle/cpu-top{k}-{N}.tsv for 100K and 1M; full: the Measurement F oracles
G2.per_size: gates first (u4m and ctrl, 500 calibration queries, k=10/100/1000, 1 warm-up + 1 measured round, exact; a failure stops the session), then one timing set per k: 3 processes per cell, rotating order (r0 u4m,ctrl; r1 ctrl,u4m; r2 u4m,ctrl), 500 queries x (3 warm-up + 20 measured rounds), batch 1, 256 threads; every timed top-k checked against the oracle
G2.statistics: per (size, k, scorer): median, p95 and p99 over the 3 x 500 per-process query medians; u4m / ctrl at the same size: geometric mean of the paired (process, query) ratios, crossed bootstrap 10,000 draws, 95% interval, seed 20261124; growth = median at 8,841,823 / median at 100,000 (document ratio 88.42; paper: 85x latency over 88x documents at batch 500); index size (bytes) and peak GPU memory per process (analysis/gpu_memory.py)

G3.what: full collection, u4m, k=1000, first 25 calibration queries
G3.clock_build: 3 warm-up + 5 measured rounds; experiments/2026-11-22-range-v3-tune/analysis/analyze_clocks.py --radix; stages mapped onto the paper's categories: allocation/zeroing = setup (lookup + zero, word-table prefix), traversal = decode+add, top-k = local top-k (radix select + gather, bitonic sort) + candidate write + threadfence + done ticket + merge
G3.ncu: 25 launches; sections SpeedOfLight, MemoryWorkloadAnalysis, Occupancy, LaunchStats; metrics dram__bytes_read.sum, dram__bytes_write.sum, gpu__dram_throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed, sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_active (achieved occupancy), lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct (L2 hit rate), gpu__time_duration.sum; base clocks, caches flushed per pass

correctness: every GPU process's top-k equals the CPU oracle; a mismatch stops the session

estimate.gpu_time: about 37 min (full collection: 6 gate processes ~6 min, 18 timing processes ~22.5 min with ~40 s index load each; 1M ~4.5 min; 100K ~1.5 min; G3 ~2.5 min); below the owner's 45 min limit
estimate.gpu_memory: at most ~3.9 GB per process (full collection: u4m ~3.4 GB, ctrl ~3.9 GB, Measurement F)

gpu_policy: idle check before every GPU process (no compute process, none of our GPU jobs, no other run_* script outside the session); when busy, retry every 300 s up to 6 h after launch, then stop and report; a process that overlaps another user's GPU process is preserved and rerun (at most 3 per slot); experiments/2026-11-22-range-v3-tune/code/session_lib.sh and overlap.py (read only)
outputs: results/2026-11-23-range-v3-g/<run>/; compressed top-k listings and Nsight reports to run-bulk with SHA-256
